name: Weapon Material Mastery — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Weapon Material Mastery from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Weapon Material Mastery (Weapon Mastery)" but are not part of the Weapon Material Mastery entry, which is unchanged.

Note Although most combat techniques are general enough to be categorized as combat feats, some are so specific in their application or require such a high level of martial skill that they are instead categorized as weapon mastery feats. The weapon mastery feats in this section, however, apply to melee weapon attacks rather than ranged attacks. As with the ranged weapon mastery feats, characters without the weapon training class feature can access these feats using the Martial Focus feat.
